passages.title: The Honest Betrayal
passages.text: Every translator begins with a small betrayal. The Italians compress the idea into a pun, traduttore, traditore, but the pun flatters the critic more than it describes the craft. To translate is not to carry a sentence across a river like a parcel; it is to rebuild the house on the other bank, using local brick, and to persuade the original owner that it is still his home. The faithful translator, who renders every word in its dictionary sense, often produces a text that is accurate and dead. The free translator, who lets the music of the new language lead, risks smuggling in meanings the author never intended. Neither is innocent. What distinguishes the good translator is not the avoidance of loss, which is impossible, but the choice of what to lose. A joke may have to surrender its pun to keep its tone; a lament may give up its rhyme to keep its rhythm. Readers who demand a perfect equivalent are asking for something that no two languages have ever possessed. They would do better to regard translation as a long conversation in which the original is never silenced, only answered.

passages.title: The Keeper
passages.text:
The lamp has turned for forty years,
a slow and patient eye,
that never asks the ships their names
nor why they hurry by.
He trims the wick, he wipes the glass,
he logs the wind and weather,
and tells himself the sea is kind
to those who keep together.

But nights come when the fog descends
and swallows light whole,
and he must trust that somewhere out
a sailor reads the toll
of that same beam he cannot see
reach anyone at all;
a faith as thin as breath on glass,
yet strong enough to haul
the heaviest of hulls from rock
to harbour, one by one,
while no one learns his name or thanks
the man whose work is done.

Still, when the dawn undoes the dark
and gulls resume their cries,
he climbs the stair, he trims the wick,
and does not ask what size
the thanks he never gets would be;
the light itself replies.

passages.title: Slow Witnesses
passages.text: Lichens are not single organisms but stable partnerships between a fungus and one or more photosynthetic partners, usually green algae or cyanobacteria. The fungus supplies a protective structure that retains moisture, while the alga manufactures sugars from sunlight. Because lichens lack roots and a waxy cuticle, they absorb water and dissolved substances directly through their surfaces, taking up pollutants along with nutrients. This is why many species are sensitive to sulphur dioxide: in industrial cities of the nineteenth century, the disappearance of leafy lichens from tree trunks marked the arrival of polluted air long before instruments could measure it. Ecologists therefore use lichen communities as bioindicators, comparing the abundance of pollution-tolerant crusts with sensitive shrubby forms. Yet the method has limits. A lichen's absence may result from drought, altered bark chemistry or simple lack of time to colonise, since lichens grow with extraordinary slowness, sometimes less than a millimetre a year. A careful survey must therefore rule out such rival explanations before attributing a decline to pollution. The same slowness that makes lichens vulnerable also makes them useful, for their long lives record environmental change across decades.

questions.question: Only after the results were announced ___ the students realise their mistake.
questions.explanation: A clause beginning with "Only after/when ..." takes subject-auxiliary inversion in the main clause; the past event needs "did + base verb". The other options do not form a correct inversion.

questions.question: If she had accepted the Delhi offer last year, she ___ in Raipur now.
questions.explanation: A past unreal condition (third-conditional if-clause) with a present result needs "would + base verb" (mixed conditional). "Would not have lived" refers to a past result; the others are ungrammatical.

questions.question: It is high time you ___ seriously about your future.
questions.explanation: "It is high time + subject" takes the past tense form (unreal present/future need): "started". The base form or will-future is not used.

questions.question: She is one of those teachers who ___ never content with rote methods.
questions.explanation: In "one of those ... who", the relative pronoun "who" refers to the plural "teachers", so the verb is plural: "are".

questions.question: Choose the correct pair: "The number of applicants ___ increasing, while a number of posts ___ still vacant."
questions.explanation: "The number of" is singular (the number itself is increasing), whereas "a number of" means "several" and takes a plural verb.

questions.question: He said, "I will have finished the work by the time you return." Choose the correct indirect speech.
options: He said that he will have finished the work by the time I return.
He said that he had finished the work by the time I had returned.
He said that he would finish the work by the time I returns.
He said that he would have finished the work by the time I returned.
questions.explanation: After a past reporting verb, "will have" becomes "would have", and the present-tense time clause "you return" backshifts to "I returned".

questions.question: Which sentence uses "that" INCORRECTLY?
options: The book that I bought yesterday is useful.
Everything that glitters is not gold.
Mount Everest, that is the highest peak in the world, lies in Nepal.
This is the house that Jack built.
questions.explanation: "That" can introduce only defining (restrictive) clauses; a non-defining clause set off by commas needs "which" or "who". The other sentences are defining clauses and correct.

questions.question: You ___ bought so much rice; we already had plenty at home.
questions.explanation: "Needn't have + past participle" means the action was done but was unnecessary. "Didn't need to" does not imply it was bought; "mustn't have" and "couldn't have" express deduction.

questions.question: There is ___ evidence against him, so the court is likely to acquit him.
questions.explanation: "Evidence" is uncountable, so a few/few are wrong. "Little" has a negative sense (almost none), which fits acquittal; "a little" would suggest some evidence exists.

questions.question: Ravi can play the guitar, and so ___ his sister.
questions.explanation: In "so + auxiliary + subject", the auxiliary must echo the one in the first clause: "can".

questions.question: In the sentence "The peace talks fell through at the last moment", the phrasal verb means
questions.explanation: "Fall through" means to fail or collapse before completion. It does not mean postponement, success or a brief interruption.

questions.question: Choose the correct transformation of "As soon as the bell rang, the students rushed out."
options: Hardly did the bell ring when the students rushed out.
Hardly had the bell rung when the students rushed out.
Hardly the bell had rung than the students rushed out.
Hardly had the bell rung than the students rushed out.
questions.explanation: "Hardly" takes inversion with the past perfect (had + subject + past participle) and is followed by "when", not "than".

questions.question: He hardly ever visits you, ___?
questions.explanation: "Hardly ever" makes the clause negative in meaning, so the tag is positive; the verb is "visits", so the auxiliary is "does".

questions.question: Choose the correct completion: "Not until the results were announced ___ how well he had done."
questions.explanation: A sentence beginning with "Not until…" takes subject-auxiliary inversion in the main clause: "did he realise". The other options keep normal word order or are ungrammatical.

questions.question: In "The fact that he was absent surprised everyone", the clause "that he was absent" is a
questions.explanation: The clause explains the noun "fact", so it is a noun clause in apposition. A relative clause would modify with who/which; "that" here is a conjunction, not a pronoun.

questions.question: The company issued a statement to ___ the rumours about its closure.
questions.explanation: "Dispel" collocates with rumours, doubts and fears. "Disperse" is for crowds, "dissipate" for energy or fog, and "discard" for objects.

questions.question: Parents must try to ___ a balance between discipline and affection.
questions.explanation: "Strike a balance" is the fixed collocation. Hit, cut and draw do not collocate with "balance" in this sense.

questions.question: In "She gave the door a hard kick", the word "kick" is an example of
questions.explanation: The same form is used as a noun with no affix added; this is conversion (zero derivation). Back-formation removes an affix, clipping shortens a word, and blending merges two words.

questions.question: Lexical bundles such as "it is important to note that" are best described as
options: frequently recurring multi-word sequences, often structurally incomplete and non-idiomatic
compound words written with a hyphen
questions.explanation: Bundles are corpus-identified, recurrent word sequences whose meaning is compositional; they are not idioms or proverbs.

questions.question: To "bell the cat" means to
options: betray a secret to an enemy
undertake a risky task on behalf of a group
questions.explanation: From the fable of the mice who needed someone to tie a bell on the cat, the idiom means to take on a dangerous job for others.

questions.question: A "red herring" in a detective story is
options: a misleading clue that diverts attention
a minor character who helps the police
questions.explanation: A red herring is a false lead intended to distract; the other options describe unrelated ideas.

questions.question: "The White House denied the allegations." Here "The White House" is an example of
questions.explanation: A name associated with the President's office is used in place of the officials themselves: metonymy (association, not part-for-whole).

questions.question: "She is no fool", meaning "She is very clever", is an example of
questions.explanation: Litotes affirms something by denying its opposite, with deliberate understatement.

questions.question: Which of the following is a paradox rather than an oxymoron?
options: "The more you learn, the less you feel you know."
questions.explanation: A paradox is a statement that seems self-contradictory but expresses a truth; the others are two-word contradictory phrases, i.e. oxymorons.

questions.question: "She lost her keys and her temper" illustrates
questions.explanation: One verb ("lost") governs two objects in different senses, literal and figurative: zeugma.

questions.question: The repetition of a word or phrase at the END of successive clauses is called
questions.explanation: Epistrophe repeats the closing word/phrase; anaphora repeats the opening; anadiplosis repeats the last word of one clause at the start of the next; polysyndeton uses many conjunctions.

questions.question: The Greek root "chron" in "synchronise" means
questions.explanation: "Chron(os)" means time, and "syn-" means together; synchronise = to happen at the same time.

questions.question: The word "benevolent" is formed from Latin roots meaning
questions.explanation: Bene = well, volens = wishing. "Well-speaking" is benediction and "well-doing" is beneficent.

questions.question: Which pair illustrates polysemy rather than homonymy?
options: the mouth of a river / the mouth of a person
bark (of a tree) / bark (of a dog)
questions.explanation: In polysemy one word has related senses (the opening metaphor). The other pairs are unrelated words sharing a form, i.e. homonyms.

questions.question: The detective made ___ enquiries so as not to alarm the neighbours.
questions.explanation: "Discreet" means careful and tactful; "discrete" means separate, a near-homophone trap. The other options do not fit the meaning.

questions.question: The passage chiefly argues that
options: faithful translation is always superior to free translation
translators should avoid rendering jokes and laments
good translation lies in deliberately choosing what to sacrifice, since some loss is unavoidable
two languages can eventually achieve perfect equivalence
questions.explanation: The author says the good translator is distinguished "not by avoiding loss, which is impossible, but by the choice of what to lose". The other options contradict or distort this.

questions.question: The author's attitude to the pun "traduttore, traditore" is that it
options: is clever but gives an incomplete account of translation
is a historical fact about Italian translators
questions.explanation: The pun "flatters the critic more than it describes the craft": it is witty but inadequate. The author neither fully endorses nor condemns it.

questions.question: The image of rebuilding "the house on the other bank" suggests that translation is
options: an act of recreation, not mere transfer
a task best done by the original author
questions.explanation: The parcel image is rejected; the house image shows re-creation with new materials. The other options are not supported.

questions.question: All of the following are supported by the passage EXCEPT:
options: A word-for-word rendering can leave a text lifeless.
A rhyme may be sacrificed to retain rhythm.
A translation continues a dialogue with the original.
A translation can, with enough skill, be made free of every loss.
questions.explanation: The author insists that loss is impossible to avoid, so the first option is unsupported; the rest are stated or implied.

questions.question: In the passage, "smuggling in" meanings most nearly means
questions.explanation: The free translator introduces unintended meanings covertly; the verb is used figuratively, not literally.

questions.question: "A slow and patient eye" is used for the lamp. This is
questions.explanation: The lamp is directly called an eye without "like" or "as"; hence a metaphor (with a touch of personification).

questions.question: "A faith as thin as breath on glass" suggests that the keeper's trust is
questions.explanation: Breath on glass is faint and fleeting, but the poem adds that the faith is "strong enough to haul" ships to harbour.

questions.question: In the line "the fog descends and swallows light whole", the fog is made to seem
options: a gentle blanket that protects sailors
a signal sent by the lighthouse
a barrier built by the keeper
a hungry creature that devours the light
questions.explanation: "Swallows" gives the fog an animal-like act of devouring, a personification that stresses how total the darkness is.

questions.question: The tone of the poem can best be described as
questions.explanation: The keeper "does not ask" for thanks; the speaker admires the steady dedication and does not complain or mock.

questions.question: "The light itself replies" suggests that
options: the lamp has become a living creature
the keeper's work is its own reward
ships send signals back to the keeper
dawn arrives to thank the keeper
questions.explanation: The keeper does not need gratitude: the beam that guides ships is the answer to his question. The other options take the line literally.

questions.question: According to the passage, the fungus in a lichen mainly
options: provides a protective structure that retains moisture
absorbs sulphur dioxide to purify the air
questions.explanation: The alga does photosynthesis; the fungus supplies structure and moisture. Lichens lack roots.

questions.question: Lichens are sensitive to air pollutants chiefly because they
options: absorb substances directly through their surface
questions.explanation: They lack roots and a cuticle and so take in dissolved pollutants along with nutrients.

questions.question: The sentence "Yet the method has limits" signals
options: a conclusion that the method is useless
a repetition of the previous point
a shift from the method's strengths to its cautions
an example of the method in action
questions.explanation: "Yet" introduces a contrast; the following sentences list reasons for caution, not a rejection of the method.

questions.question: "Such rival explanations" refers to
options: the fungus-alga partnership and sugar production
drought, altered bark chemistry and slow colonisation
questions.explanation: The preceding sentence lists these other causes of lichen absence besides pollution.

questions.question: The final sentence of the passage conveys that
options: a feature that makes lichens vulnerable also makes them valuable as records
lichens are useless for long-term study
slow growth is a disadvantage to ecologists
lichens live only a few years
questions.explanation: The "same slowness" is both a weakness and a source of usefulness. The other options reverse the point.

questions.question: Asher's Total Physical Response (TPR) is especially suitable for
questions.questionHi: आशर की टोटल फ़िज़िकल रिस्पॉन्स (TPR) विधि विशेष रूप से किसके लिए उपयुक्त है?
options: beginners, because learners respond physically to commands before speaking
learners who wish to study translation
optionsHi: निबंध लिखने वाले उन्नत शिक्षार्थियों के लिए
आरंभिक सीखने वालों के लिए, क्योंकि वे बोलने से पहले निर्देशों पर शारीरिक क्रिया से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं
अनुवाद सीखने के इच्छुक शिक्षार्थियों के लिए
questions.explanation: TPR links speech with action: learners show comprehension through movement, which lowers anxiety and suits beginners. It is not designed for essays or criticism.
questions.explanationHi: TPR में भाषा को क्रिया से जोड़ा जाता है; शिक्षार्थी हरकत से समझ दिखाते हैं, जिससे चिंता कम होती है और यह आरंभिक स्तर के लिए उपयुक्त है।

questions.question: In Cummins' framework, CALP refers to
questions.questionHi: कमिंस के ढाँचे में CALP का अर्थ है
options: the language proficiency needed for academic, cognitively demanding tasks
the ability to pronounce words accurately
optionsHi: शैक्षणिक एवं संज्ञानात्मक रूप से कठिन कार्यों के लिए आवश्यक भाषा दक्षता
शब्दों का सही उच्चारण करने की क्षमता
केवल व्याकरण के नियमों का ज्ञान
questions.explanation: CALP (Cognitive Academic Language Proficiency) takes about 5-7 years; BICS is everyday conversational language acquired in about two years.
questions.explanationHi: CALP शैक्षणिक भाषा दक्षता है, जिसे विकसित होने में लगभग 5-7 वर्ष लगते हैं; BICS रोज़मर्रा की बोलचाल की भाषा है, जो लगभग 2 वर्ष में आ जाती है।

questions.question: Hymes introduced the term "communicative competence" mainly in reaction to
questions.questionHi: हाइम्स ने "संप्रेषणात्मक सक्षमता" शब्द मुख्यतः किसकी प्रतिक्रिया में प्रस्तुत किया?
options: Chomsky's notion of linguistic competence that ignored social appropriateness
optionsHi: पियाजे के संज्ञानात्मक विकास के चरण
चॉम्स्की की भाषिक सक्षमता की धारणा, जिसमें सामाजिक उपयुक्तता की उपेक्षा थी
questions.explanation: Hymes argued that knowing grammar is not enough; a speaker must also know what is appropriate in a social context. This challenged Chomsky's idealised competence.
questions.explanationHi: हाइम्स ने कहा कि केवल व्याकरण जानना पर्याप्त नहीं; सामाजिक संदर्भ में क्या उपयुक्त है, यह जानना भी ज़रूरी है। यह चॉम्स्की की आदर्श सक्षमता को चुनौती थी।

questions.question: Swain's Output Hypothesis claims that
questions.questionHi: स्वेन की आउटपुट परिकल्पना का दावा है कि
options: comprehensible input alone is sufficient for acquisition
producing language pushes learners to notice gaps and process language syntactically
learners acquire language only by listening
optionsHi: केवल बोधगम्य निवेश (input) ही अधिगम के लिए पर्याप्त है
त्रुटियों को कभी नहीं सुधारना चाहिए
भाषा का उत्पादन सीखने वालों को अपनी कमियाँ पहचानने और वाक्य-रचना को गहराई से समझने के लिए प्रेरित करता है
सीखने वाले केवल सुनकर भाषा सीखते हैं
questions.explanation: Swain proposed that speaking/writing makes learners notice what they cannot say, test hypotheses and process grammar deeply; it contrasts with Krashen's input-only view.
questions.explanationHi: स्वेन के अनुसार बोलने/लिखने से सीखने वाला अपनी कमियाँ देखता है, परिकल्पनाएँ जाँचता है और व्याकरण पर गहराई से काम करता है; यह क्रैशन के केवल-निवेश दृष्टिकोण से भिन्न है।

questions.question: Long's Interaction Hypothesis emphasises that language development is promoted by
questions.questionHi: लॉन्ग की अंतःक्रिया परिकल्पना के अनुसार भाषा विकास को किससे बढ़ावा मिलता है?
options: negotiation of meaning during conversational interaction
optionsHi: बातचीत के दौरान अर्थ की वार्ता (negotiation of meaning)
questions.explanation: When partners clarify, confirm and repair misunderstanding, input becomes comprehensible and acquisition is facilitated.
questions.explanationHi: जब वार्ताकार स्पष्टीकरण, पुष्टि और सुधार करते हैं तो निवेश बोधगम्य बनता है और अधिगम आसान होता है।

questions.question: In Krashen's Affective Filter Hypothesis, a "high" filter means that
questions.questionHi: क्रैशन की भावात्मक फ़िल्टर परिकल्पना में "उच्च" फ़िल्टर का अर्थ है कि
options: anxiety or low motivation blocks input from becoming intake
the learner is highly motivated and confident
the teacher uses more corrective feedback
optionsHi: चिंता या कम प्रेरणा निवेश को आत्मसात होने से रोकती है
सीखने वाला अत्यधिक प्रेरित और आत्मविश्वासी है
सीखने वाला व्याकरण तेज़ी से सीखता है
शिक्षक अधिक सुधारात्मक प्रतिपुष्टि देता है
questions.explanation: A high filter (anxiety, low self-esteem, low motivation) prevents input from being absorbed; a low filter promotes acquisition.
questions.explanationHi: उच्च फ़िल्टर (चिंता, कम आत्म-सम्मान, कम प्रेरणा) निवेश को ग्रहण होने से रोकता है; निम्न फ़िल्टर अधिगम को बढ़ावा देता है।

questions.question: A child using language to find out about the world ("Tell me why") serves, in Halliday's scheme, the
questions.questionHi: हैलिडे की योजना में दुनिया के बारे में जानने के लिए ("मुझे बताओ क्यों") भाषा का प्रयोग करने वाला बच्चा किस प्रकार्य की पूर्ति करता है?
questions.explanation: The heuristic function uses language to learn and investigate; the regulatory controls behaviour, the imaginative creates imaginary worlds and the instrumental gets needs satisfied.
questions.explanationHi: अन्वेषणात्मक प्रकार्य में भाषा का उपयोग जानने-सीखने के लिए होता है; नियामक व्यवहार को नियंत्रित करता है, कल्पनात्मक काल्पनिक संसार रचता है और साधनात्मक आवश्यकताएँ पूरी करता है।

questions.question: Fossilisation in second language learning refers to
questions.questionHi: द्वितीय भाषा अधिगम में फ़ॉसिलाइज़ेशन (fossilisation) का अर्थ है
options: the learner's loss of the first language
permanent stabilisation of incorrect forms in the learner's interlanguage
the growth of vocabulary through reading
optionsHi: सीखने वाले की मातृभाषा का लुप्त हो जाना
सीखने वाले की अंतर्भाषा में गलत रूपों का स्थायी रूप से जम जाना
questions.explanation: Fossilisation (Selinker) is the persistence of non-target forms despite exposure and instruction.
questions.explanationHi: सेलिंकर के अनुसार फ़ॉसिलाइज़ेशन में शिक्षण और अभ्यास के बाद भी गलत रूप बने रहते हैं।

questions.question: Compared with contrastive analysis, error analysis
questions.questionHi: विरोधी विश्लेषण (contrastive analysis) की तुलना में त्रुटि विश्लेषण (error analysis)
options: predicts all errors by comparing L1 and L2 grammars
studies actual learner errors, many of which are not due to L1 transfer
assumes errors are always caused by L1 interference
optionsHi: L1 और L2 के व्याकरण की तुलना करके सभी त्रुटियों का पूर्वानुमान लगाता है
सीखने वालों की वास्तविक त्रुटियों का अध्ययन करता है, जिनमें से कई मातृभाषा के प्रभाव से नहीं होतीं
सीखने वालों के लिखित उत्पादन की उपेक्षा करता है
मानता है कि त्रुटियाँ सदैव L1 के हस्तक्षेप से होती हैं
questions.explanation: Contrastive analysis predicts difficulty from L1-L2 differences; error analysis examines real errors and finds many are developmental or intralingual.
questions.explanationHi: विरोधी विश्लेषण L1-L2 के अंतर से कठिनाइयों का अनुमान लगाता है; त्रुटि विश्लेषण वास्तविक त्रुटियों को देखता है और पाता है कि अनेक विकासात्मक या भाषा-आंतरिक होती हैं।

questions.question: Content and Language Integrated Learning (CLIL) is best described as
questions.questionHi: विषय-वस्तु एवं भाषा एकीकृत अधिगम (CLIL) को सबसे अच्छे ढंग से कहा जा सकता है
options: teaching a subject through a second/foreign language so that both content and language are learned
replacing the mother tongue by English completely
teaching only language skills without any subject content
optionsHi: किसी विषय को द्वितीय/विदेशी भाषा के माध्यम से पढ़ाना ताकि विषय-वस्तु और भाषा दोनों सीखी जाएँ
अनुवाद अभ्यास के माध्यम से व्याकरण सिखाना
मातृभाषा को पूरी तरह अंग्रेज़ी से बदल देना
बिना विषय-वस्तु के केवल भाषा कौशल सिखाना
questions.explanation: CLIL has a dual focus: the subject matter and the target language are taught together.
questions.explanationHi: CLIL का दोहरा उद्देश्य है: विषय-वस्तु और लक्ष्य भाषा दोनों साथ-साथ सिखाई जाती हैं।

questions.question: In the revised (Anderson-Krathwohl) taxonomy, asking students to write an original short story targets which level?
questions.questionHi: संशोधित (एंडरसन-क्रैथवोल) वर्गीकरण में विद्यार्थियों से मौलिक लघु कहानी लिखवाना किस स्तर को लक्षित करता है?
questions.explanation: In the revised taxonomy, Create is the highest level, involving producing something new; the others are lower-order.
questions.explanationHi: संशोधित वर्गीकरण में सृजन उच्चतम स्तर है, जिसमें कुछ नया बनाया जाता है; अन्य निम्न स्तर हैं।

questions.question: A teacher supplies a sentence frame, then gradually withdraws it as learners become able to write independently. This is an application of
questions.questionHi: एक शिक्षक वाक्य-ढाँचा देता है और सीखने वालों के स्वतंत्र लिखने योग्य होने पर उसे धीरे-धीरे हटा लेता है। यह किसका अनुप्रयोग है?
options: scaffolding within the Zone of Proximal Development
questions.explanation: Temporary support that fades as competence grows is scaffolding (Bruner, from Vygotsky's ZPD).
questions.explanationHi: योग्यता बढ़ने के साथ हटती जाने वाली अस्थायी सहायता स्कैफ़ोल्डिंग है (वाइगोत्स्की के ZPD पर आधारित, ब्रूनर)।

questions.question: Before planning remedial teaching in English, the first step should be
questions.questionHi: अंग्रेज़ी में उपचारात्मक शिक्षण की योजना बनाने से पहले पहला चरण होना चाहिए
options: assigning extra homework to the whole class
diagnosing the specific nature and cause of the learners' difficulties
repeating the same lesson in the same manner
optionsHi: पूरी कक्षा को अतिरिक्त गृहकार्य देना
सीखने वालों की कठिनाइयों के विशिष्ट स्वरूप और कारण का निदान करना
वही पाठ उसी तरीके से दोहराना
बार-बार होने वाली त्रुटियों पर दंड देना
questions.explanation: Remedial work is effective only when based on diagnosis of the specific problem; repetition or punishment does not address the cause.
questions.explanationHi: उपचारात्मक शिक्षण तभी प्रभावी है जब वह विशिष्ट समस्या के निदान पर आधारित हो; दोहराव या दंड से कारण का समाधान नहीं होता।

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of communicative competence in the Canale and Swain (1980) model?
questions.questionHi: कैनेल और स्वेन (1980) के मॉडल में संप्रेषणात्मक सक्षमता का घटक निम्न में से कौन-सा नहीं है?
questions.explanation: The 1980 model has grammatical, sociolinguistic and strategic competence (discourse competence was added later by Canale in 1983). "Behavioural competence" is not part of it.
questions.explanationHi: 1980 के मॉडल में व्याकरणिक, समाज-भाषावैज्ञानिक और युक्तिपरक सक्षमता थी (विमर्श सक्षमता बाद में 1983 में जोड़ी गई)। "व्यवहारात्मक सक्षमता" इसका भाग नहीं है।

questions.question: Translanguaging in a multilingual classroom means
questions.questionHi: बहुभाषी कक्षा में ट्रांसलैंग्वेजिंग (translanguaging) का अर्थ है
options: banning all languages other than English in class
translating every sentence word by word
using learners' full linguistic repertoire, including home languages, as a resource for learning
optionsHi: कक्षा में अंग्रेज़ी के अलावा सभी भाषाओं पर प्रतिबंध लगाना
हर वाक्य का शब्दशः अनुवाद करना
सीखने वालों की संपूर्ण भाषाई पूँजी, जिसमें घर की भाषाएँ भी शामिल हैं, को अधिगम के संसाधन के रूप में प्रयोग करना
questions.explanation: Translanguaging flexibly draws on all languages the learner knows to build understanding; it is not prohibition or mechanical translation.
questions.explanationHi: ट्रांसलैंग्वेजिंग में सीखने वाले की सभी ज्ञात भाषाओं का लचीले ढंग से उपयोग समझ बनाने के लिए होता है; यह निषेध या यांत्रिक अनुवाद नहीं है।

questions.question: A student refuses to cheat because "a good person looks after relationships and cares for everyone affected". Gilligan's critique of Kohlberg would call this reasoning an
questions.questionHi: एक विद्यार्थी नकल करने से मना करता है क्योंकि "अच्छा व्यक्ति रिश्तों का ध्यान रखता है और प्रभावित सभी की परवाह करता है।" कोहलबर्ग की गिलिगन द्वारा की गई आलोचना के अनुसार यह तर्क क्या है?
questions.explanation: Gilligan argued that Kohlberg's scheme prioritised an ethic of justice and that many (especially girls) reason from an ethic of care and responsibility.
questions.explanationHi: गिलिगन ने कहा कि कोहलबर्ग का सिद्धांत न्याय की नैतिकता को प्राथमिकता देता है, जबकि बहुत-से लोग (विशेषकर लड़कियाँ) देखभाल और ज़िम्मेदारी की नैतिकता से सोचते हैं।

questions.question: A 16-year-old boy keeps trying different roles, friends and ideas to understand who he is. According to Erikson, he is going through the crisis of
questions.questionHi: 16 वर्ष का एक लड़का यह समझने के लिए कि वह कौन है, अलग-अलग भूमिकाएँ, मित्र और विचार आज़माता रहता है। एरिक्सन के अनुसार वह किस संकट से गुज़र रहा है?
questions.explanation: Adolescence (about 12-18 years) is the stage of identity versus role confusion. Industry vs inferiority is 6-12; initiative vs guilt 3-6; intimacy vs isolation is young adulthood.
questions.explanationHi: किशोरावस्था (लगभग 12-18 वर्ष) में पहचान बनाम भूमिका भ्रम की अवस्था होती है। उद्यमिता बनाम हीनता 6-12 वर्ष, पहल बनाम अपराध-बोध 3-6 वर्ष और आत्मीयता बनाम अलगाव युवावस्था में होती है।

questions.question: A 14-month-old drops toys from different heights to see what happens each time. In Piaget's sensorimotor period, this is characteristic of
questions.questionHi: 14 माह का शिशु यह देखने के लिए कि हर बार क्या होता है, खिलौनों को अलग-अलग ऊँचाई से गिराता है। पियाजे की संवेदी-गामक अवस्था में यह किसकी विशेषता है?
questions.explanation: Tertiary circular reactions (12-18 months) involve deliberate experimentation with variation; primary reactions centre on the infant's own body, secondary on repeating interesting effects on objects.
questions.explanationHi: तृतीयक वृत्तीय प्रतिक्रियाएँ (12-18 माह) में शिशु जानबूझकर प्रयोग करता है; प्राथमिक अपने शरीर पर केंद्रित होती हैं और द्वितीयक रोचक प्रभावों को वस्तुओं पर दोहराने से जुड़ी होती हैं।

questions.question: Vygotsky differed from Piaget chiefly in holding that
questions.questionHi: वाइगोत्स्की पियाजे से मुख्यतः किस बात में भिन्न थे?
options: social interaction and guided help lead cognitive development
language plays no role in thought
optionsHi: सामाजिक अंतःक्रिया और मार्गदर्शित सहायता संज्ञानात्मक विकास को आगे बढ़ाती है
बच्चे अकेले में सबसे अच्छा सीखते हैं
चिंतन में भाषा की कोई भूमिका नहीं
questions.explanation: Vygotsky stressed that learning in a social context pulls development forward; Piaget saw development as largely preceding learning, driven by individual construction.
questions.explanationHi: वाइगोत्स्की ने ज़ोर दिया कि सामाजिक संदर्भ में अधिगम विकास को आगे खींचता है; पियाजे विकास को अधिकतर व्यक्तिगत रचना से संचालित और अधिगम से पहले मानते थे।

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of Cattell's crystallised intelligence?
questions.questionHi: निम्न में से कौन-सा कैटेल की क्रिस्टलीकृत बुद्धि का उदाहरण है?
options: using vocabulary and general knowledge acquired over the years
solving a novel pattern puzzle quickly
remembering a new phone number briefly
optionsHi: वर्षों में अर्जित शब्दावली एवं सामान्य ज्ञान का उपयोग करना
किसी नई पहेली को शीघ्र हल करना
अपरिचित अमूर्त प्रतीकों के साथ तर्क करना
नया फ़ोन नंबर थोड़े समय के लिए याद रखना
questions.explanation: Crystallised intelligence is knowledge and skills accumulated through experience and culture; fluid intelligence is novel problem-solving that is less dependent on prior learning.
questions.explanationHi: क्रिस्टलीकृत बुद्धि अनुभव और संस्कृति से अर्जित ज्ञान व कौशल है; तरल बुद्धि नई समस्याओं को हल करने की क्षमता है जो पूर्व अधिगम पर कम निर्भर है।

questions.question: Guilford linked creativity most closely with
questions.questionHi: गिलफ़ोर्ड ने सृजनात्मकता को सबसे अधिक किससे जोड़ा?
questions.explanation: Divergent thinking (many original answers to an open problem) is the core of creativity; convergent thinking seeks a single correct answer.
questions.explanationHi: अपसारी चिंतन (खुली समस्या के अनेक मौलिक उत्तर) सृजनात्मकता का मूल है; अभिसारी चिंतन एक सही उत्तर खोजता है।

questions.question: If the same test is administered twice to the same group after a gap and the scores are correlated, the coefficient obtained is a measure of
questions.questionHi: यदि एक ही परीक्षण एक ही समूह को अंतराल के बाद दो बार दिया जाए और प्राप्तांकों का सहसंबंध निकाला जाए, तो प्राप्त गुणांक किसका माप है?
questions.explanation: Correlation between two administrations of the same test gives test-retest reliability (stability); split-half uses one administration split into halves.
questions.explanationHi: एक ही परीक्षण को दो बार देकर प्राप्तांकों का सहसंबंध पुनः परीक्षण (स्थिरता) विश्वसनीयता देता है; अर्ध-विच्छेद में एक ही प्रशासन को दो भागों में बाँटा जाता है।

questions.question: In item analysis, an item answered correctly by 90% of the upper group and 30% of the lower group has a discrimination index of
questions.questionHi: प्रश्न-विश्लेषण में, किसी प्रश्न का उत्तर उच्च समूह के 90% और निम्न समूह के 30% ने सही दिया। उसका विभेदन सूचकांक कितना है?
questions.explanation: Discrimination index = proportion correct in upper group minus proportion correct in lower group = 0.90 - 0.30 = 0.60.
questions.explanationHi: विभेदन सूचकांक = उच्च समूह का सही अनुपात - निम्न समूह का सही अनुपात = 0.90 - 0.30 = 0.60।

questions.question: A teacher prepares a blueprint (table of specifications) to ensure that an achievement test covers all units and objectives in proportion. This mainly improves its
questions.questionHi: एक शिक्षक यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए ब्लूप्रिंट (विनिर्देश तालिका) बनाता है कि उपलब्धि परीक्षण सभी इकाइयों और उद्देश्यों को अनुपात में समेटे। इससे मुख्यतः क्या सुधरता है?
questions.explanation: A blueprint ensures representative sampling of content and objectives, i.e. content validity.
questions.explanationHi: ब्लूप्रिंट पाठ्य-वस्तु और उद्देश्यों का प्रतिनिधिक प्रतिदर्श सुनिश्चित करता है, यानी अंतर्वस्तु वैधता।

questions.question: A driving test in which every candidate who achieves the set standard receives a licence, irrespective of how others perform, is
questions.questionHi: एक ड्राइविंग टेस्ट, जिसमें निर्धारित मानक प्राप्त करने वाले हर उम्मीदवार को, दूसरों के प्रदर्शन की परवाह किए बिना, लाइसेंस मिलता है, कैसा परीक्षण है?
questions.explanation: Criterion-referenced assessment compares performance with a fixed standard; norm-referenced compares candidates with one another.
questions.explanationHi: मानदंड-संदर्भित मूल्यांकन में निष्पादन की तुलना निश्चित मानक से होती है; मानक-संदर्भित में परीक्षार्थियों की आपस में तुलना होती है।

questions.question: According to the spiral curriculum idea of Bruner, of a spiral curriculum key concepts should be
questions.questionHi: ब्रूनर के सर्पिल पाठ्यचर्या (spiral curriculum) विचार के अनुसार मूल अवधारणाएँ होनी चाहिए
options: taught once and never returned to
introduced only in the final year
revisited repeatedly at increasing levels of complexity
optionsHi: एक बार पढ़ाकर दोबारा न छुई जाने वाली
केवल अंतिम वर्ष में आरंभ की जाने वाली
बढ़ती जटिलता के स्तरों पर बार-बार दोहराई जानी
questions.explanation: Bruner proposed that the curriculum revisit basic ideas, building on them each time with greater depth.
questions.explanationHi: ब्रूनर के अनुसार पाठ्यचर्या में मूल विचारों को बार-बार, हर बार अधिक गहराई के साथ लिया जाना चाहिए।

questions.question: In the 5E constructivist lesson model, the correct sequence is
questions.questionHi: 5E रचनावादी पाठ मॉडल में सही क्रम है
questions.explanation: The 5E model begins by engaging curiosity, then exploring, explaining, elaborating (extending) and finally evaluating.
questions.explanationHi: 5E मॉडल में पहले जिज्ञासा जगाई जाती है, फिर अन्वेषण, व्याख्या, विस्तार और अंत में मूल्यांकन होता है।

questions.question: The "Holistic Progress Card" suggested in NEP 2020 is intended to
questions.questionHi: NEP 2020 में सुझाए गए "समग्र प्रगति कार्ड" का उद्देश्य है
options: give a 360-degree view of a learner including self- and peer-assessment
report only marks in written examinations
replace all teacher assessment with machine scoring
optionsHi: स्व- एवं सहपाठी-मूल्यांकन सहित शिक्षार्थी का 360-डिग्री चित्र देना
केवल लिखित परीक्षा के अंक दर्ज करना
विद्यार्थियों को अंकों के आधार पर क्रमबद्ध करना
शिक्षक के सभी मूल्यांकन को मशीन से बदल देना
questions.explanation: The card records cognitive, affective and psychomotor progress with inputs from the student, peers and teachers; it is not rank-based.
questions.explanationHi: यह कार्ड शिक्षार्थी, सहपाठियों और शिक्षकों के इनपुट के साथ संज्ञानात्मक, भावात्मक और मनोगामक प्रगति दर्ज करता है; यह रैंक-आधारित नहीं है।

questions.question: In a constructivist classroom, the teacher's role is best described as
questions.questionHi: रचनावादी कक्षा में शिक्षक की भूमिका को सबसे अच्छी तरह कैसे बताया जा सकता है?
options: a facilitator who designs experiences for learners to build their own understanding
optionsHi: रटने को पुरस्कृत करने वाला परीक्षक
ऐसा सुगमकर्ता जो सीखने वालों के लिए अनुभव रचता है ताकि वे स्वयं समझ बनाएँ
questions.explanation: Constructivism views learners as active constructors of knowledge and the teacher as a guide/facilitator.
questions.explanationHi: रचनावाद में शिक्षार्थी ज्ञान के सक्रिय निर्माता और शिक्षक मार्गदर्शक/सुगमकर्ता होता है।

questions.question: Teachers who consistently ask science questions to boys and craft questions to girls are, in effect, reinforcing
questions.questionHi: जो शिक्षक लगातार लड़कों से विज्ञान के प्रश्न और लड़कियों से शिल्प के प्रश्न पूछते हैं, वे वस्तुतः किसे मज़बूत कर रहे हैं?
options: the hidden curriculum of gender stereotypes
optionsHi: लैंगिक रूढ़ियों के छिपे हुए पाठ्यक्रम (hidden curriculum) को
questions.explanation: Unintended messages conveyed through classroom practices form the hidden curriculum; here they reinforce gender stereotypes.
questions.explanationHi: कक्षा-व्यवहार से मिलने वाले अनजाने संदेश छिपा हुआ पाठ्यक्रम बनाते हैं; यहाँ वे लैंगिक रूढ़ियों को मज़बूत करते हैं।

questions.question: ‘षडानन’ शब्द का सही संधि-विच्छेद है
questions.explanation: ‘षट्’ के बाद स्वर ‘आ’ आने पर ट् का ड् हो जाता है और ‘षडानन’ बनता है; मूल रूप ‘षट्’ है। यह व्यंजन संधि है।

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में अव्ययीभाव समास का उदाहरण है
questions.explanation: ‘यथाशक्ति’ (शक्ति के अनुसार) में पहला पद अव्यय है। राजपुत्र तत्पुरुष, चक्रपाणि बहुव्रीहि और महापुरुष कर्मधारय है।

questions.question: मुहावरा ‘नौ दो ग्यारह होना’ का अर्थ है
questions.explanation: ‘नौ दो ग्यारह होना’ का अर्थ है चुपचाप या जल्दी से भाग जाना।

questions.question: तत्सम शब्द ‘वधू’ का तद्भव रूप है
questions.explanation: ‘वधू’ से तद्भव रूप ‘बहू’ बना है; ‘व’ का ‘ब’ और ‘ध’ का ‘ह’ हो गया।

questions.question: ‘पेड़ से पत्ता गिरा’ वाक्य में ‘से’ चिह्न किस कारक का है?
questions.explanation: जहाँ अलगाव या दूर होने का भाव हो, वहाँ ‘से’ अपादान कारक का चिह्न है। करण में साधन का भाव होता है।

questions.question: Government by the rich is called
questions.explanation: Plutocracy = rule by the wealthy; oligarchy = rule by a few; aristocracy = rule by the nobility; theocracy = rule by religious leaders.

questions.question: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: He is senior than me by two years.
He is senior to me by two years.
He is senior from me by two years.
He is senior of me by two years.
questions.explanation: Adjectives such as senior, junior, superior and inferior take "to", not "than".

questions.question: "To cut a sorry figure" means to
options: make a poor or pitiful impression
questions.explanation: The idiom means to appear in an unimpressive or embarrassing way.

questions.question: Choose the correct passive form of "They will have completed the work by Friday."
options: The work will be completed by them by Friday.
The work would have been completed by them by Friday.
The work will have completed by them by Friday.
The work will have been completed by them by Friday.
questions.explanation: Future perfect passive = will have been + past participle.

questions.question: Ramesh is ___ M.Sc. while Suresh is ___ B.Sc.
questions.explanation: Articles follow sound: "M" is pronounced "em" (vowel sound), so "an"; "B" is pronounced "bee", so "a".

questions.question: Pointing to a man, Kavita said, "His mother is the only daughter of my mother's father." How is the man related to Kavita?
questions.questionHi: एक पुरुष की ओर संकेत करके कविता ने कहा, "इसकी माँ मेरी माँ के पिता की इकलौती पुत्री है।" वह पुरुष कविता का क्या लगता है?
questions.explanation: My mother's father's only daughter is Kavita's own mother. So the man's mother is Kavita's mother, making him her brother.
questions.explanationHi: कविता की माँ के पिता की इकलौती पुत्री स्वयं कविता की माँ है। अतः पुरुष की माँ कविता की माँ है, यानी वह कविता का भाई है।

questions.question: Find the next term: 2, 6, 5, 15, 14, 42, ?

Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit in a row facing north. Q is at the extreme left and U at the extreme right. R is third from the left and P is immediately to the right of R. S is immediately to the left of U. Who sits second from the left?
questions.questionHi: छह व्यक्ति P, Q, R, S, T और U उत्तर की ओर मुँह करके एक पंक्ति में बैठे हैं। Q बाएँ छोर पर और U दाएँ छोर पर है। R बाएँ से तीसरा है और P, R के ठीक दाएँ है। S, U के ठीक बाएँ है। बाएँ से दूसरे स्थान पर कौन बैठा है?
questions.explanation: Order from left: Q, T, R, P, S, U. R is third, P is fourth, U sixth, S fifth, Q first, so T is second.
questions.explanationHi: बाएँ से क्रम: Q, T, R, P, S, U। R तीसरा, P चौथा, U छठा, S पाँचवाँ, Q पहला; अतः T दूसरा है।

questions.question: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 4:20?
questions.questionHi: घड़ी में 4:20 बजे घंटे और मिनट की सुइयों के बीच कितना कोण होता है?

questions.question: Statements: Some pens are books. All books are tables. No table is a chair. Conclusions: I. Some pens are tables. II. Some pens are not chairs. III. No pen is a chair.
questions.questionHi: कथन: कुछ पेन किताबें हैं। सभी किताबें मेज़ हैं। कोई मेज़ कुर्सी नहीं है। निष्कर्ष: I. कुछ पेन मेज़ हैं। II. कुछ पेन कुर्सी नहीं हैं। III. कोई पेन कुर्सी नहीं है।
optionsHi: केवल I और II अनुसरण करते हैं
केवल II और III अनुसरण करते हैं
questions.explanation: Pens that are books are tables, and no table is a chair; so I and II follow. Nothing is stated about all pens, so III does not follow.
questions.explanationHi: जो पेन किताबें हैं वे मेज़ हैं और कोई मेज़ कुर्सी नहीं; अतः I और II सही हैं। सभी पेनों के बारे में कुछ नहीं कहा गया, इसलिए III सही नहीं।

questions.question: In Excel, cell B2 contains =A$1*$C2. If this formula is copied to cell C3, it becomes
questions.questionHi: एक्सेल में सेल B2 में =A$1*$C2 है। इसे सेल C3 में कॉपी करने पर सूत्र हो जाएगा
questions.explanation: Moving one column right and one row down: A shifts to B (column relative), $1 stays (row absolute); $C stays (column absolute) and row 2 shifts to 3.
questions.explanationHi: एक कॉलम दाएँ और एक पंक्ति नीचे जाने पर A, B हो जाता है (कॉलम सापेक्ष), $1 वही रहता है (पंक्ति निरपेक्ष); $C वही रहता है और पंक्ति 2, 3 हो जाती है।

questions.question: The octal number 157 is equal to which decimal number?
questions.questionHi: अष्टाधारी (octal) संख्या 157 दशमलव में कितनी होती है?

questions.question: Which device uses MAC addresses to forward frames to a specific port in a LAN?
questions.questionHi: कौन-सा उपकरण LAN में MAC पते के आधार पर फ़्रेम को किसी विशेष पोर्ट तक भेजता है?
questions.explanation: A switch learns MAC addresses and sends frames only to the right port; a hub broadcasts to all ports and a repeater only regenerates signals.
questions.explanationHi: स्विच MAC पते सीखकर फ़्रेम केवल सही पोर्ट पर भेजता है; हब सभी पोर्ट पर भेजता है और रिपीटर केवल सिग्नल को पुनः उत्पन्न करता है।

questions.question: Logging in with a password plus a one-time code sent to the registered mobile is an example of
questions.questionHi: पासवर्ड के साथ पंजीकृत मोबाइल पर भेजे गए वन-टाइम कोड से लॉग-इन करना किसका उदाहरण है?
questions.explanation: Two different proofs (something you know plus something you have) make two-factor authentication. Encryption, firewalls and compression do not authenticate users.
questions.explanationHi: दो अलग प्रमाण (कुछ जो आप जानते हैं + कुछ जो आपके पास है) द्वि-कारक प्रमाणीकरण बनाते हैं; एन्क्रिप्शन, फ़ायरवॉल और संपीड़न उपयोगकर्ता का प्रमाणीकरण नहीं करते।

questions.question: In which cloud model does the provider supply virtual servers, storage and networking while the user installs the operating system and applications?
questions.questionHi: किस क्लाउड मॉडल में प्रदाता वर्चुअल सर्वर, स्टोरेज और नेटवर्किंग देता है और उपयोगकर्ता स्वयं ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम व एप्लिकेशन इंस्टॉल करता है?
questions.explanation: Infrastructure as a Service gives raw computing infrastructure; PaaS gives a platform for developers, and SaaS gives ready-made applications.
questions.explanationHi: IaaS मूल कंप्यूटिंग अवसंरचना देता है; PaaS डेवलपरों को प्लेटफ़ॉर्म देता है और SaaS तैयार एप्लिकेशन देता है।

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for the Election Commission?
questions.questionHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद निर्वाचन आयोग की व्यवस्था करता है?
questions.explanation: Article 324 vests the superintendence, direction and control of elections in the Election Commission. Article 280 is Finance Commission, 315 Public Service Commissions and 148 the CAG.
questions.explanationHi: अनुच्छेद 324 चुनावों के अधीक्षण, निदेशन और नियंत्रण का दायित्व निर्वाचन आयोग को देता है। अनुच्छेद 280 वित्त आयोग, 315 लोक सेवा आयोग और 148 CAG से संबंधित है।

questions.question: When the RBI increases the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR), the immediate effect on commercial banks is
questions.questionHi: जब RBI नकद आरक्षित अनुपात (CRR) बढ़ाता है, तो वाणिज्यिक बैंकों पर तात्कालिक प्रभाव होता है
options: a reduction in the funds available for lending
a fall in the bank rate to zero
optionsHi: ऋण देने के लिए उपलब्ध धन में कमी
बैंक दर का शून्य हो जाना
जमा ब्याज दर का स्वतः बढ़ना
questions.explanation: CRR is the share of deposits banks must keep with the RBI; raising it leaves less money to lend.
questions.explanationHi: CRR जमा का वह हिस्सा है जो बैंकों को RBI के पास रखना पड़ता है; इसे बढ़ाने पर उधार देने के लिए कम धन बचता है।

questions.question: The Poona Pact (1932) was signed after Gandhi's fast against
questions.questionHi: पूना समझौता (1932) गांधीजी के किस के विरुद्ध उपवास के बाद हुआ?
optionsHi: रैमज़े मैक्डोनाल्ड का सांप्रदायिक पंचाट (Communal Award)
questions.explanation: Gandhi fasted in Yerwada jail against separate electorates for the Depressed Classes; the Pact with Ambedkar gave them reserved seats in joint electorates.
questions.explanationHi: गांधीजी ने येरवदा जेल में दलित वर्गों के लिए पृथक निर्वाचक मंडल के विरुद्ध उपवास किया; अंबेडकर के साथ पूना समझौते में संयुक्त निर्वाचन में आरक्षित सीटें दी गईं।

questions.question: Which temple of Chhattisgarh, built by the Nagvanshi rulers in Kabirdham district, is called the "Khajuraho of Chhattisgarh"?
questions.questionHi: छत्तीसगढ़ का कौन-सा मंदिर, जो कबीरधाम जिले में नागवंशी शासकों ने बनवाया, "छत्तीसगढ़ का खजुराहो" कहलाता है?
questions.explanation: Bhoramdeo temple, with sculptures on its outer walls like Khajuraho, is called the Khajuraho of Chhattisgarh. The others are famous for other reasons.
questions.explanationHi: भोरमदेव मंदिर की बाहरी दीवारों की मूर्तिकला खजुराहो जैसी है, इसलिए इसे छत्तीसगढ़ का खजुराहो कहते हैं; अन्य मंदिर अन्य कारणों से प्रसिद्ध हैं।

questions.question: The escape velocity from the surface of the Earth is approximately
questions.questionHi: पृथ्वी की सतह से पलायन वेग लगभग होता है
questions.explanation: Escape velocity = sqrt(2gR), about 11.2 km/s. 7.9 km/s is the orbital velocity near the surface and 9.8 is the value of g in m/s^2.
questions.explanationHi: पलायन वेग = वर्गमूल(2gR) लगभग 11.2 किमी/से है। 7.9 किमी/से निकट-सतह कक्षीय वेग है और 9.8 g का मान (मी/से^2) है।
